description: This PHP source file defines server-side functionality for search management in the TestLink open source test management tool. It initializes parameters, checks user permissions, and processes search requests, rendering search results with a Smarty template engine.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering HTML templates.

classes.name: searchCommands
classes.description: Handles search command processing, argument parsing, and GUI configuration within the search management.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments, sanitizes input, and retrieves test project info.

methods.name: initializeEnv
methods.description: Sets up environment variables and user permissions for the search page.

methods.name: processSearch
methods.description: Main function to prepare and display search results using the template engine.

methods.name: getSearchSkeleton
methods.description: Creates a basic template object for search input.
